text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I received some pickled
vegetables
from my hometown, and as I
was eating them, I
felt strangely
uplifted.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That must be it. It was a reminder of all
the
support I receive from back home.
choice_data_list: Because so much heart went into it.

text_block_list.text:
I've got a feeling that I'm gonna run well
in my
next race. I'll win this one—I
promise.

Seeing Oguri Cap so motivated gives me
high
hopes for the upcoming race.
